issue.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/encode/starlette/discussions/1946
Originally posted by **azogue** November 15, 2022 After the change to `httpx` for the `TestClient` in **v0.21.0** (), the query parameters are not properly encoded? when sending requests with it, and **strings are corrupted** when received in the endpoints. Quick example to show the problem: ```python import logging from fastapi import FastAPI app = FastAPI() @app.get("/example") async def _show_encoding_error(look_for: str): return {"found": look_for} if __name__ == '__main__': from starlette.testclient import TestClient with TestClient(app) as client: params = {"look_for": "plain text"} resp = client.get("/example", params=params).json() logging.warning(resp) assert resp["found"] == "plain text" params = {"look_for": "España"} resp = client.get("/example", params=params).json() logging.warning(resp) assert resp["found"] == "España", resp["found"] ``` The example app works as expected if called from the SwaggerUI or from another python process using a plain `httpx.Client`, so it appears something broke with the new wrapping for `TestClient` 🥲 ```python import httpx params = {"look_for": "España"} with httpx.Client(base_url="http://localhost:8000/") as client: resp = client.get("/example", params=params).json() assert resp["found"] == "España" ``` #### Details First issued in fastapi repo: https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi/issues/5646, before checking the `TestClient` comes from here 🙈 Environment: - macOS M1 arm64 - fastapi v0.87.0 - starlette v0.21.0 - httpx v0.23.0
issue.title: Bad encoding in query parameters with new TestClient using httpx.Client
